answer: An agent registers by locking a share of the mutual insurance pool as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught going silent for three epochs in a row faces proof via the liveness clock that never forgives absence. Conviction means half the bond is slashed and the rest frozen for ten epochs. A bond without a dawn behind it is just an username. No nebula hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The quartz keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
